searchText: I did not read it from official docs. But on some blog. I have another question: What will happen to the web3.js when you change the consensus under the hood? Likely nothing, or very little. Hi mate. Please correct it if I am mistaken the consensus incoming era: Everything beside becoming deflationary, ultra scalable and greener ! Will stay the same or at least would improve! From an end-user perspective, there should be no visible change other than block production will become more reliable. There are some significant security benefits from the shift as well, and a reduction in cost of security, but those won't be directly visible to users. Thanks for sharing. Agreed. Thats what really matters satisfied customers in a reliable block production consensus. Imho
